items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: And Reese Haber-Herschel at the Brill Bill

ctx.x: You were talking about the rainy night there and you came in with umbrellas and all that, raincoats there, with Tommy Lyman. Go ahead. I got it. Well, in the morning it was time to go home,

when he see an umbrella, he jumped from here to that next room. He says, you bore the hell out of me. He says, my brothers went out, what do you call them? High-heft boots. High-button shoes. High-button shoes. And we were waking up at the piping rock, the porter comes along in the morning, sweeping along in the bar, see. He said, you let me get a drink then. You want a drink of this? Yeah, so. I drink beer. So I get a beer. And along comes the porter sweeping the floor with all the small brooms. And he sees that…
